##### Project general facts

Aqua Maya is a boutique coastal residential development by BNW Developments, located on Al Marjan Island. Designed as a serene island address, the project blends contemporary architecture with a calm, nature-led lifestyle, drawing inspiration from the rhythm of the sea and the balance of natural elements. The building’s sculptural, balcony-led façade mirrors soft ocean waves, while the landscaped podium and open layouts create a seamless connection between indoor spaces and the surrounding environment.

The project is conceived for residents who value privacy, comfort, and a slower pace of living. Residences are arranged to maximise natural light, cross-ventilation, and views, fostering a sense of openness while maintaining intimacy. Shared spaces are thoughtfully curated to support everyday routines, from relaxation and wellness to family-friendly leisure, forming a cohesive, community-oriented living experience by the sea.

Interiors at Aqua Maya are finished with high-end materials and a refined, neutral palette that emphasises clarity and elegance. Residences feature premium finishes, acoustically soundproofed walls, humidity-controlled cooling systems, and individual thermostats for enhanced comfort. Kitchens are integrated seamlessly into the living spaces with a functional, contemporary design, while the overall specification focuses on durability, functionality, and understated luxury. 

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
